description:
Implement the 'Swipe-to-Refresh' pattern in the BookStream application.

1. Add the `androidx.swiperefreshlayout:swiperefreshlayout:1.1.0` (or newer) dependency to the app-level `build.gradle.kts` file.
2. Modify `app/src/main/res/layout/activity_main.xml` to wrap the existing `RecyclerView` inside a `androidx.swiperefreshlayout.widget.SwipeRefreshLayout`. Assign the ID `@+id/swipe_refresh` to the SwipeRefreshLayout.
3. In `MainActivity.kt`, find the SwipeRefreshLayout and set an `OnRefreshListener`. Inside the listener, call `viewModel.refreshData()` and then immediately hide the refresh indicator by setting `isRefreshing = false`.
4. Verify the implementation by building the project.
